app.title: University Simulator
app.tagline: Ziqhelanise nesemester yakho yokuqala phambi kokuba ibeyinyani.
home.hook: Malunga nama-620 000 eminyaka yokuqala eyayixhaswe yi-NSFAS ngo-2023. Kuphela yi-130 000 eyayisafumana inkxaso-mali kunyaka olandelayo.
home.what: Dlala iiveki ezisibhozo zesemester yakho yokuqala eyunivesithi malunga nemizuzu eli-10. Gxotha imali, amanqaku kunye nempilo ngexesha lentlekele yeminyaka yokuqala ejongene nayo, emva koko ugcine isicwangciso sokusinda sobomi bokwenyani.
home.privacy: Akukho akhawunti kwaye akukho kubhalisa. Iimpendulo zakho zihlala kwesi sixhobo.

home.f3.body: Uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali olwakhiwe kumvuzo wakho wokwenyani, incwadi yokudlala kade kunye nabafowunelwa bakho benkxaso.

intro.1.title: Ukungena ngumngeni omnye. Ukugqiba ngomnye.
intro.1.body: Malunga nabafundi aba-6 kwabali-10 abaqala isidanga okanye idiploma bagqiba kwisithuba seminyaka elishumi. Uninzi lweengxaki ezisendleleni zinokuqikelelwa: izibonelelo zasemva kwexesha, irenti, izicelo zosapho kunye noxinzelelo lweveki yovavanyo.
intro.2.title: Yiqhelisele ngaphambi kokuba ibeyinyani
intro.2.body: Misela imeko yakho yokwenyani, emva koko udlale iiveki ezisi-8 malunga nemizuzu eli-10. Iveki nganye izisa imeko enye kunye nokukhetha ezimbini okanye ezintathu. Jonga imali yakho, amanqaku kunye nempilo yakho, kwaye ucele uncedo ukuze ubone inkxaso kwiikhampasi zenkxaso.
intro.3.title: Uhambo lwakho, isahluko ngesahluko
intro.3.body: Qala ngokuFika okanye iXesha lokuQala, emva koko ulandele uhambo lwakho ukuya kuthi ga kwisidanga. Emva kwesahluko ngasinye, i-Semester Forecast iqikelela iiveki zakho ezinobungozi kwaye yakha isicwangciso sokusinda ukuze ugcine okanye wabelane nge-WhatsApp. Akukho akhawunti, kwaye isebenza ngaphandle kweintanethi.

Akukho xabiso lize lithathe yonke imali yakho: xa imfutshane uthenga kancinci, kwaye uhambe ngaphandle kokunye. Malunga {income} ingena qho ngeveki, kwaye uqala ngo- {start}.

home.title: University Simulator
home.about: Isikhokelo senkxaso kwikhampasi epokothweni yomfundi ngamnye. Fumana inkonzo eyiyo ngento oyifunayo, phinda uziqhelanise nobomi baseyunivesithi phambi kokuba yenzeke, kwaye ucwangcisele imali, amanqaku kunye nempilo.
home.card.setupNew: Yila umfundi wakho: iyunivesithi, ikhosi, ikhaya, imali nokunye. Kuthatha malunga nomzuzu.
home.card.firstDesc: Ukufika, iKota yokuQala, iiMviwo zokuQala nokuBuyela kwiMeko: unyaka abafundi abaninzi abawufumana unzima kakhulu.
home.card.middleDesc: Unyaka wesibini nowesithathu: iimali ezindala, ukufudukela ngaphandle kwekhampasi, ukukhetha isifundo esiphambili, imisebenzi esecaleni nokudinwa.
home.card.finalDesc: Iiprojekthi zonyaka wokugqibela, izicelo zemisebenzi, amatyala amadala nosuku lokuthweswa isidanga.

Ezi ngxaki ziyaqikelelwa, kwaye noncedo luyaqikelelwa.
how.title: Ziqhelanise, emva koko ugcine isicwangciso
how.help1: Khetha iyunivesiti yakho kube kanye, emva koko ufumane uncedo ngento ojongene nayo, njengokuthi "Ndilambile" okanye "Isibonelelo sam sisemva kwexesha": ngubani omawuqhagamshelane naye, uya phi kwaye xa ivuliwe. Isebenza ngaphandle kweintanethi.
how.help2: Izihloko ezinzima, ezifana nocalucalulo, ukuxhatshazwa kunye nokhuseleko. Ngamnye ubonisa ukuba ngubani onceda kwikhampasi yakho, kunye neefowuni zoncedo zesizwe.
how.s1: Imeko yakho yokwenyani: iyunivesithi, ikhosi, indawo yokuhlala, inkxaso-mali, imali, ikhaya noxanduva. Umdlalo wakhiwa ngayo.
how.s2: Iveki nganye izisa imeko yokwenyani kunye nokukhetha ezimbini okanye ezintathu. Jonga imali yakho, amanqaku kunye nempilo yakho. Ungayitshintsha impendulo emva kokuba uyenzile.
how.s3: Khetha ukufumana uncedo kwaye uya kuyibona inkonzo kwiyunivesiti yakho: into eyenzayo, apho ikhoyo kunye nendlela yokufikelela kuyo.
how.s4: Emva kwesahluko ngasinye, uQikelelo lweSemester luqikelela iiveki zakho ezinomngcipheko kakhulu kwaye lwakhe isicwangciso sokusinda onokusigcina okanye usabelane ngaso kuWhatsApp.
how.note: Phakathi kwamanyathelo kukho ikhefu, apho unokuyeka kwaye ubuye kamva. Ngamanye amaxesha ibamba umbuzo okhawulezayo ozikhethelayo: ezo aziyonxalenye yebali eliphambili kwaye azitshintshi amanqaku akho okanye intlalontle, kodwa nantoni na okhetha ukuyithenga iphuma kwimali yakho. Akukho akhawunti. Isebenza ngaphandle kweintanethi. Malunga nemizuzu eli-10 kwikota yokuqala.
home.cardsLead: Yenza umlinganiswa wakho, emva koko udlale nayiphi na indawo yohambo: abafundi abasathatha isigqibo, abokuqala unyaka kunye nabafundi abasele bekunyaka wesibini bonke bamkelekile.
home.helpLead: Iinkonzo zeyunivesiti yakho, zifunyenwe yile nto uyidingayo. Akukho mlinganiswa ofunekayo.

about.title: Malunga neYunivesithi Simulator
about.lead: Umdlalo omfutshane apho abafundi baseMzantsi Afrika baziqhelanisa nobomi baseyunivesithi phambi kokuba kwenzeke.
about.p1: Umisela umfundi onjengawe, udlale izahluko ezimfutshane ukusuka kwimatriki ukuya kuthweso-zidanga, kunye nemali, amanqaku kunye nempilo entle. Wonke umzuzu onzima unendlela, kwaye kukho ukuphumelela endleleni.
about.p2: Emva kwesahluko ngasinye, i-Semester Forecast ifunda ukhetho lwakho kwaye yakha isicwangciso sokusinda onokuthi usigcine. I-forecast isebenzisa imithetho ecacileyo, esekelwe kuphando.
about.independent: IYunivesithi yaseSizwe iyintsomi. Le app izimele, kwaye ayidityaniswanga okanye ivunywe yiyo nayiphi na iyunivesiti.
about.advice: Eli asilongcebiso yobuchwephesha, yezemali, yezomthetho okanye yezonyango. Ngoncedo olungxamisekileyo, sebenzisa iinombolo zoncedo zelizwe eziboniswe kwi-app.
about.numbers: Amanani, imithetho kunye nemihla yimizekelo. Jonga ezokwenyani ngeyunivesithi yakho kunye nomxhasi wakho.
uni.title: Ikhampasi yakho, kumdlalo
uni.lead: Iiyunivesithi zedemo ziyintsomi. Inguqulelo enelayisensi inika abafundi bakho ukuziqhelanisa neyunivesithi yakho, kunye neenkonzo zakho kunye neendleko zakho.
uni.s1: Ikhadi ngalinye, iindleko kunye nenkonzo yenkxaso yidatha. Ipakethi yakho ibiza iiofisi zakho zokwenyani, indlela yokufikelela kuzo kwaye zeziphi izinto ezixabisa kufutshane nekhampasi yakho.
uni.s2: Iqela lakho leMicimbi yaBafundi lijonga lonke ikhadi lenkxaso kunye nomxholo obuthathaka phambi kokuba abafundi balibone. Uhlaziyo lufikelela kubafundi ngaphandle kwe-app entsha.
uni.s3: Uyabona ukuba bangaphi abafundi abagqibe isahluko ngasinye kunye nendlela abaphendule ngayo imibuzo emithathu ongazikhetha. Akukho magama, akukho ukungena kwaye akukho rekhodi zabafundi.
uni.s4: Iilayisenisi zeziko ngalinye nangonyaka, ngokwemigangatho ngokwamanani abafundi. Ikhampasi yedemo yaseSizwe ihlala ikhululekile ukuzama.
privacy.title: Ubumfihlo, ngolwimi olulula
privacy.lead: Akukho akhawunti kwaye akukho login. Asikhe sikubuze igama, inombolo okanye inombolo yomfundi.
privacy.p1: Iimpendulo zakho zokuseta, ukhetho, inkqubela phambili kunye nezicwangciso ezigciniweyo zigcinwa kwesi sixhobo kuphela.
privacy.p2: Iinyani zekhampasi azilandelelwa. Akukho nto malunga nento oyivulayo egcinwayo okanye ethunyelwayo, nakwisixhobo sakho.
privacy.p3: Xa ugqiba isahluko, i-app ithumela ukubala okungaziwa kwixesha elizayo xa uku-intanethi: ikhowudi yesixhobo esingaqhelekanga, iyunivesiti yakho, igama lesahluko kunye nomhla. Awudingi ukucofa nantoni na kule nto. Iimpendulo zengxelo zithunyelwa kuphela xa ucofa Thumela.
privacy.p5: Ukwabelana ngesicwangciso sakho sokusinda kulukhetho lwakho, kwaye kuya kuphela apho usithumela khona.
cr.title: Iinyani zekhampasi
cr.lead: Ezinye izinto ekhampasini kunzima ukuthetha ngazo. Eli candelo likunceda ukuba uzibone, wazi iinketho zakho kwaye uxhase umhlobo wakho.
cr.note: Inqaku lomxholo: ezi zihloko ziquka ucalucalulo kunye nobundlobongela obuphathelele kwezesondo. Funda ngesantya sakho, kwaye uhambe nanini na xa ufuna. Uncedo lwasimahla, oluyimfihlo luyafumaneka ngoku:
cr.topicNote: Amakhadi alandelayo achaza esi sihloko ngokucacileyo, kunye nemeko emfutshane. Akukho nto ifunyenweyo, kwaye akukho nto malunga nokubonayo egciniweyo. Ukuphuma ngokukhawuleza kukubuyisela ngqo kwizihloko.
cr.private: Akukho nto malunga nokujonga apha egciniweyo okanye ethunyelwayo.
cr.reviewed: La magama ajongwa ngokutsha yingcali yokuxhasa abafundi.
cr.noScore: Akukho nto ifunyenwe apha. Khetha inketho yokubona ukuba ithande ukukhokelela phi.
cr.youNote: Iinketho, ngesantya sakho. Akukho xinzelelo lokuxela.
cr.fromCard: Kukho okungakumbi koku kwiCampus Realities, kwiscreen sasekhaya. Kunyanzelekile.
cr.cardDesc: Iindawo ezinzima zobomi bekhampasi: ucalucalulo, ukuxhatshazwa, ukuxhatshazwa kunye nokhuseleko. Ziqaphele, zazi iinketho zakho, xhasa umhlobo kwaye ubone ukuba ngubani onceda kwikhampasi yakho.

fc.details: Bona iinkcukacha: umngcipheko ngeveki, indlela oye wahlangabezana ngayo, inkcitho kunye nemali
link.leaving: Oku kuvula iwebhusayithi esemthethweni kwisikhangeli sakho. Isebenzisa idatha.
link.noSite: {short} IYunivesithi iyintsomi, ngoko ke akukho webhusayithi yokuvula. Kwikhampasi enelayisensi oku kuya kwiphepha leyunivesithi.
coach.homeSetup: Qala apha: cofa "Yenza umlinganiswa" ukuseta umfundi onjengawe. Kuthatha malunga nomzuzu. Emva koko ukhetha apho uqala khona: akufuneki udlale iinxalenye ngokulandelelana.
coach.homeYears: Cofa "Vula" kuyo nayiphi na indawo yohambo. Akuyomfuneko ukuba uzidlale ngokulandelelana.
coach.recap: Ezi ziinkonzo ongeke udibane nazo okwangoku. Cofa enye ukuze ubone ukuba ibonelela ngantoni, iphi kwaye ufikelela njani kuyo.
coach.card: Funda imeko, uze ucofe impendulo ibe nye. Ungayitshintsha emva koko.
coach.outcome: Oku kukhokelele kuyo ukhetho lwakho. Cofa iqhosha elingezantsi ukuze uqhubeke, okanye "Shintsha impendulo yam" ukuzama enye.
coach.support: Ukhetho lwakho luvule inkonzo yenkxaso. Cofa u-"Jonga inkxaso" ukuze ufumane ukuba inikezela ngantoni kunye nendlela yokufikelela kuyo.
coach.reach: Cofa imephu, i-imeyile okanye iqhosha lephepha ukuze ubone ngqo apho ungaya khona. Yonke into oyivulayo igcinwe kwisicwangciso sakho sokusinda.
coach.break: Eli likhefu phakathi kwamanyathelo. Ungama apha kwaye ubuye kamva: inkqubela phambili yakho igciniwe.
coach.mini: Lo ngumbuzo ozikhethelayo. Ayiyonxalenye yebali eliphambili kwaye ayisoze yatshintsha amanqaku okanye impilo yakho, kodwa nantoni na okhetha ukuyithenga iphuma kwimali yakho. Yiphendule okanye uyitsibe.
coach.forecast: Olu luqikelelo lwakho: ezona veki ziyingozi kwaye wenze ntoni ngazo. Cofa "Jonga iinkcukacha" ngakumbi, emva koko uqhubeke nesicwangciso sakho sokusinda.
coach.meters: Ezi ziimitha zakho ezintathu: imali, amanqaku kunye nempilo. Lonke ukhetho luyabashukumisa. Ukuba impilo yehla ngaphantsi kwe-35%, amanqaku akho ayathotywa qho ngeveki.
coach.week: "{since}" idwelisa imali eyangena kwaye yaphuma ukususela kwisinyathelo sokugqibela, njengesibonelelo sakho, ukutya kunye nesithuthi.
coach.plans: Sonke isicwangciso sokusinda osigqibayo sigcinwe apha. Zivule nanini na, nangaphandle kweintanethi.
coach.budget: Uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali lwakho lwahlulwe ngokwepesenti. Guqula naliphi na inani kunye nohlaziyo lwemali ukuze lihambelane.
setup.campusHint: Ikhampasi nganye inemephu yayo, iinkonzo kunye neendleko zendawo. Ezinye ii-ofisi zaseyunivesithi zikwiKhampasi ePhambili kuphela.
setup.pickHint: Iinkonzo zahlukile kwiyunivesiti nganye. Khetha eyakho ukuze ubone ukuba ngubani oza kuqhagamshelana naye, uya phi kwaye xa ivuliwe.
setup.noMatch: Akukho yunivesithi ihambelana naloo nto. Zama igama elifutshane.
setup.needOnline: Qhagamshelana kwi-intanethi kube kanye ukuze ukhuphele eli ziko. Emva koko isebenza ngaphandle kweintanethi.

svc.cardDesc: Fumana uncedo ngento ojongene nayo, nangaliphi na ixesha: "Ndilambile", "ndigxininisekile", "ndifumene ikhowudi yesiphumo".
svc.lead: Cofa into ojongene nayo ukuze ubone ukuba ngubani okuncedayo, baphi kwaye ufikelela njani kubo.
svc.visiting: Umhlobo wakho wabelane nawe ngale nto. Ezi ziinkonzo e- {inst}, hayi eyakho ikhampasi.
svc.shareLink: Jonga apho ikhoyo kunye nendlela yokufikelela kuyo:
svc.noMatch: Akukho nkonzo ihambelana naloo nto. Zama igama elifutshane.
coach.terms: Amagama abhalwe ngqindilili anokucofwa. Cofa enye ukuze ubone ukuba ithetha ukuthini.
coach.services: Ungayifumana yonke inkonzo kwakhona, nangaliphi na ixesha, phantsi kwe "Iinkonzo zeKhampasi" kwisikrini sasekhaya.
plan.imageMore: Isicwangciso esipheleleyo sigcinwe kwi-app phantsi kwezicwangciso zam ezigciniweyo, kwaye zinokukhutshelwa njengePDF.
setup.reask: {inst} ayinikezi mpendulo yakho yangaphambili apha, nceda ukhethe kwakhona.
plans.title: Izicwangciso zam ezigciniweyo
plans.cardDesc: Sonke isicwangciso sokusinda osigqibayo sigcinwe kule fowuni. Yifunde kwakhona okanye uyikhuphele njengePDF, ngaphandle kokuphinda uyidlale.
plans.lead: Igcinwe kule fowuni kuphela. Ukucima yonke into ekwiphepha laBucala kuyabasusa nabo.
plans.none: Akukho zicwangciso zigciniweyo okwangoku. Gqibezela isahluko ukuze ufumane esinye.
plans.kept: Igcinwe kwizicwangciso zam ezigciniweyo kule fowuni, ngoko unokubuyela kuyo nanini na.
plans.broken: Esi sicwangciso asinakuphinda sivulwe. Dlala isahluko kwakhona ukuze ufumane esitsha.
